command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.local/share/omegacv1-test-platform/source
GO_ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.local/share/omegacv1-test-platform/toolchains/go1.27.1
EXPECTED=e01905d58b60c441e4dd4b92c825faec4a6054ae
test -x "$GO_ROOT/bin/go"
export PATH="$GO_ROOT/bin:$PATH"
cd "$ROOT"
git fetch origin main
git checkout main
git reset --hard origin/main
HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo repo_head="$HEAD"
test "$HEAD" = "$EXPECTED"
go version
./scripts/validate-research-surface.sh
./scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh inspect
./scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh stage
./scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh verify-stage
echo git_mode=$(git ls-files -s scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh | awk '{print $1}')
PROV="/home/ai-core-node/.local/share/omegacv1-test-platform/releases/$HEAD/PROVENANCE.env"
echo provenance_begin
cat "$PROV"
echo provenance_end
sha256sum "/home/ai-core-node/.local/share/omegacv1-test-platform/releases/$HEAD/omegacv1"
echo CRUSH006_CURRENT_MAIN_STAGE_GATE_PASS
